THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 6, 1937

C. J. LEMCKE ORDERED
TO "VACATE"

Problem of Palmer and
Turner's Judgment

Judge Milton J. Helmick was given
a knotty problem to solve in the U.S.
Court for China yesterday. Plaintiffs,
Messrs. Palmer & Turner, who had
secured judgment for certain rents
in arrears against Mr. Carl J. Lemcke
some time ago, maintained that the
judgment had yet to be satisfied;
defendant maintained that the plain-
tiffs had refused to accept any money
from him, as they had already
received the amount of the judgment
in full.
The matter was finally cleared up
by plaintiff's counsel, Mr. Paul F.
Kops, who told the Court that,
although Palmer & Turner had in fact
received the money, they had
received it from his own law firm,
and not from the defendant, who had
yet to satisfy the judgment. The
case arose when a motion came be-
fore the Court asking for a citation
and for an order evicting Mr. Lemcke
from the premises in Avenue Foch.
Mr. Roy Allman, counsel for defen-
dant, said that while it was admitted
that his client was now three months
in arrears with his rent, the amount
owing on the judgment secured aga-
inst him had been paid in full. His
client, who had occupied the premises
for the last five years would require
a month's notice before vacating. An
argument then ensued between
counsel as to whether or not the
judgment had been satisfied, Mr.
Kops maintaining that the payment
of the amount of the judgment by
his firm to their clients, in order to
oblige them, did not release Mr.
Lemcke from his obligations, and Mr.
Allman maintaining that since the
judgment had been, in fact, satisfied,
plaintiffs could not bring in their
present motion under that particular
judgment.
Judge Helmick finally ordered that
the date of the filing of the motion
by the plaintiffs, December 29, 1936,
be construed as a month's notice to
vacate, although this was a "very
unsatisfactory state of affairs for re-
cording."

《字林西报》，1937年1月6日，星期三

C. J. 莱姆克被令
“搬离”

帕尔默与特纳事务所判决之问题

昨日，美国在华法院的米尔顿·J·赫尔米克（Milton J. Helmick）法官面临一个棘手的难题。原告帕尔默与特纳事务所（Palmer & Turner）此前已就拖欠租金问题对卡尔·J·莱姆克（Carl J. Lemcke）先生取得胜诉判决，他们坚持认为该判决尚未得到履行；被告则坚称原告拒绝接受其任何款项，因为原告已全额收到了判决确定的金额。

此事最终由原告代理律师保罗·F·科普斯（Paul F. Kops）先生向法庭说明而得以澄清。他告诉法庭，虽然帕尔默与特纳事务所确实收到了这笔钱，但款项是来自其所在的律师事务所，而非来自被告，因此被告尚未履行判决义务。本案起因于向法院提出的一项动议，要求发出传票并命令莱姆克先生搬离霞飞路（Avenue Foch）的房产。

被告代理律师罗伊·奥尔曼（Roy Allman）先生表示，虽然承认其客户目前拖欠三个月租金，但针对其客户所获判决的欠款金额已全额付清。其客户在过去五年中一直居住在该处，要求在搬离前给予一个月通知。随后，双方律师就判决是否已履行展开辩论，科普斯先生坚称，其事务所为了取悦客户而代为支付判决金额，并不能免除莱姆克先生的义务；而奥尔曼先生则坚称，既然判决事实上已得到履行，原告便不能依据该特定判决提出当前的动议。

赫尔米克法官最终裁定，将原告提交动议的日期即1936年12月29日视为一个月的搬离通知，尽管他指出这是一种“非常令人不满的记录状态”。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Wednesday, July 22, 1936

Hit-Run Drivers
Rouse Police Ire

Accidents Continuing
With Carelessness
Predominant

Much resentment is being expressed by police and the public of Shanghai this morning over the recurrence of hit-and-run automobile cases and the alleged lack of cooperation on the part of drivers of automobiles who fail to stop after collisions with pedestrians or vehicles.

Another accident occurred about 1 o'clock this morning on Avenue Edward VII near Lungmen Road, but this time the drivers did not "run away." Two cars collided and three persons were injured. Two of these are men and one is a woman, they were taken to the Red Cross Hospital where after being treated for lacerations, contusions and brain concussions they were allowed to leave for their respective homes.

Ricksha Hit

The latest accident to arouse the ire of police is the one wherein a public ricksha was struck by a passing automobile on The Bund near Garden Bridge about 2 a.m. on Monday morning. Both the puller and the passenger of the ricksha were thrown out of their vehicle when the car struck it.

It is reliably reported by witnesses to the accident that a foreigner was driving the car and that there were two lady passengers, who laughed at the time of the collision.

Driver In Bed

As a policeman took down the license number of the car, the owner was immediately traced. It proved to be a Mr. Hodgman living in the French Concession. A detective was put on watch at his home and waited for his return. When daylight had arrived and the owner had not yet put in his appearance, inquiries resulted in the information that Mr. Hodgman was still in bed and that he had placed his car in the Lincoln Motor Sales at the corner of Avenue Haig and Avenue Foch. Subsequent police inquiries added the information from Mr. C. J. Lucas that he had rented the automobile to a foreigner at 9:30 p.m. on Saturday after-
noon but that he didn't know the
foreigner's name.

肇事逃逸司机
激起警方愤怒

事故频发
粗心大意为主因

今晨，上海警方及公众对肇事逃逸汽车案件的再次发生，以及对那些在与行人或车辆碰撞后不停车的司机据称缺乏合作的行为，表达了强烈的不满。

今日凌晨1点左右，爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）靠近龙门路（Lungmen Road）处又发生一起事故，但这次司机并未“逃逸”。两辆汽车相撞，三人受伤。其中两名为男性，一名为女性，他们被送往红十字会医院，在接受了撕裂伤、挫伤和脑震荡治疗后，获准各自回家。

人力车被撞

最近一起激起警方愤怒的事故发生在周一凌晨2点左右，地点在外滩靠近外白渡桥处，一辆过往汽车撞上了一辆公共人力车。汽车撞击时，人力车夫和乘客均被甩出车外。

据事故目击者可靠报告，驾车者为一名外国人，车内有两名女乘客，在碰撞发生时她们还在大笑。

司机在床上

当一名警察记下该车车牌号后，车主随即被追踪到。车主是一名住在法租界的霍奇曼（Hodgman）先生。一名侦探在其住所蹲守，等待其归来。天亮后车主仍未出现，经查询得知霍奇曼先生仍在床上睡觉，且已将车停在海格路（Avenue Haig）与霞飞路交界处的林肯汽车销售行（Lincoln Motor Sales）。警方随后的调查从 C. J. 卢卡斯（C. J. Lucas）先生处获悉，他于周六下午9:30将该汽车租给了一名外国人，但他不知道该外国人的姓名。

THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, JULY 24, 1936

Two Hurt As
Auto Collide
With Omnibus

New Accidents Report-
ed As Police Run
Down Old Ones

Two Chinese, both men, were slightly injured when the automobile in which they were riding collided with a bus on Bubbling Well Road almost directly in front of the Foreign Y.M.C.A. shortly after noon yesterday.

Both men were taken to the Lester Chinese Hospital where examination revealed that one had sustained an injured foot while the other had received a cut on the chin. It was reported that the car had swerved in an effort to avoid striking a pedestrian and that the bus, traveling in the opposite direction, struck the car's fenders.

Including the two injured in the Bubbling Well Road accident, four persons sustained cuts and bruises yesterday as the result of street accidents. One Chinese male pedestrian, who was crossing Nanking Road near Lloyd Road, was knocked down by a motor-car. He escaped serious injury but had to be taken to the hospital to receive treatment for a lacerated scalp. This accident occurred at 12.18 p.m.

Chinese Cyclist Hit

A Chinese bicyclist was taken to the Red Cross Hospital at 1.10 p.m. yesterday suffering from concussion of the brain. The man was riding along Avenue Road near Tsang Za Rd. when he swerved suddenly in order to avoid being struck by a passing motor-car. He lost control of the bicycle and fell to the pavement, striking his head.

In the meantime, automobile accidents continue to monopolize the attention of the traffic department of the Shanghai Municipal Police while at the same time, officials of Greater Shanghai are also beginning to have their troubles in this respect.

The serious injury of two officers of the Peace Preservation Corps on Great Western Road came to light yesterday when it was announced that they were victims of a hit-and-run driver. The two men were standing on the sidewalk when a car, traveling at high speed, mounted the curb and struck them. One officer suffered a broken leg while the other sustained severe bruises. The driver did not stop but continued on his way. Police are now investigating the incident and hope to apprehend the culprit soon.

Meanwhile, investigations are continuing their investigation in connection with the accident on the Bund near Garden Bridge Monday when a truck overturned and crushed a rickshaw, killing the coolie and seriously injuring the passenger. The truck driver has been detained pending further inquiries. It is believed that the accident was caused by excessive speed and failure to observe traffic regulations.

两人受伤

警方追查旧案之际

昨日中午过后不久，两名中国男子乘坐的汽车在南京路（Bubbling Well Road，即静安寺路）青年会（Foreign Y.M.C.A.）正前方附近与一辆公交车相撞，两人受轻伤。

两人均被送往莱斯特长老会医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），检查显示一人脚部受伤，另一人下巴割伤。据报道，该车为避让行人而突然转向，对面驶来的公交车撞上了该车的挡泥板。

包括南京路事故中的两名伤者在内，昨日共有四人因街道事故遭受割伤和挫伤。一名中国男性行人在靠近劳合路（Lloyd Road）的南京路过马路时被一辆汽车撞倒。他幸免重伤，但需送医治疗头皮撕裂伤。该事故发生在下午12:18。

中国骑车人被撞

昨日下午1:10，一名中国骑自行车者因脑震荡被送往红十字会医院。该男子沿上海路（Avenue Road）靠近西藏路（Tsang Za Rd.）骑行时，为避让过往汽车突然转向。他失去对自行车的控制摔倒在人行道上，头部着地。

昨日，两名保安队（Peace Preservation Corps）军官在大西路（Great Western Road）受重伤一事曝光，据悉他们是肇事逃逸司机的受害者。这两名男子当时站在人行道上，一辆高速行驶的汽车冲上路缘石撞向他们。一名军官腿部骨折，另一名遭受严重挫伤。司机未停车，继续驶离。警方正在调查此事，希望尽快抓获肇事者。

与此同时，针对周一在外滩靠近外白渡桥处发生的事故调查仍在进行，当时一辆卡车翻车压碎了一辆人力车，导致车夫死亡，乘客重伤。卡车司机已被拘留，以待进一步调查。据信，事故原因是超速及未遵守交通规则。

Subject Report on Information Supplied by U.S.Marshal.
re Activities of LEMCKE, American Citizen.

Made by D.S.I. Pryde Forwarded by D.I. Bennett.

Sir,
On the morning of 13-6-36 Mr. Faupel, U. S. Marshal, supplied the following information regarding the activities of Carl. J. Lemcke, American citizen, which he suspects are of a criminal nature and requested assistance to keep this man under observation.

Recently Lemcke rented about two mows of land in the environs of Point Island, Yangtzepoo. Also one named Charles Bowers, believed to be an American citizen, recently purchased on behalf of Lemcke, two motor boats named " Johnnie " and " Minnie ", which are usually moored alongside the piece of land referred to above.

Lemcke has also rented a garage situated at No. 38 Lorton Terrace, Rue Lorton, French Concession, in the name of P. T, Comstock. Lemcke has been seen to place a light "Fiat" truck in this garage, late at night on the past three Saturdays ( June 6th.; May 30th.; and May 23rd.). Early on the following Sunday mornings this truck is driven away by a foreigner believed to be a Russian. This "Fiat" truck bears French Trade Licence Plate No. 61 and Chinese trade licence plate No. 38. The body of the truck is painted white, the doors yellow and the wheels red.

The U. S. Marshal surmises that this truck and the two motor boats are being used for some nefarious purposes, probably the smuggling of either drugs or guns and requested the assistance of the S. M. Police to keep watch on the boats and the garage.

D.I. Bennett and D.S.I. Pryde visited Point Island on 15-6-36 but were unable to locate these motor boats.

先生，
1936年6月13日上午，美国法警福佩尔（Faupel）先生提供了以下关于美国公民卡尔·J. 莱姆克（Carl. J. Lemcke）活动的信息，他怀疑这些活动具有犯罪性质，并请求协助对该人进行监视。

最近，莱姆克在杨树浦Point Island（音译）附近租赁了约两亩土地。另有一名名为查尔斯·鲍尔斯（Charles Bowers）的人，据信为美国公民，最近代表莱姆克购买了两艘分别名为“约翰尼”（Johnnie）和“明妮”（Minnie）的摩托艇，这两艘船通常停泊在上述地块旁。

莱姆克还以P. T. 康斯托克（P. T, Comstock）的名义，在法租界劳尔登路（Rue Lorton）劳尔登露台38号租赁了一间车库。在过去的三个星期六（6月6日；5月30日；以及5月23日），有人看到莱姆克在深夜将一辆轻型“菲亚特”卡车放入该车库。次日清晨，这辆卡车由一名据信是俄罗斯人的外国人开走。这辆“菲亚特”卡车挂有法国贸易牌照第61号和中国贸易牌照第38号。卡车车身漆成白色，车门为黄色，车轮为红色。

美国法警推测，这辆卡车和两艘摩托艇正被用于某些非法目的，可能是走私毒品或枪支，并请求上海公共租界警务处协助监视船只和车库。

督察贝内特和副督察普赖德于1936年6月15日前往Point Island（音译），但未能找到这些摩托艇。

In order to find out what was behind the attached

I telephoned Lemcke this morning at his office address, No.361

Morris appeared to know exactly what was required by Lemcke.
I passed myself off as a person anxious to dispose of a boat,
and in order to ascertain whether the vessel was required for
use on the Whangpoo alone I intimated that the boat I had to
offer was of the outboard motor type which, while entirely
suitable for use in local waters, was hardly safe if intended
for the Yangtsze river or the open sea. I then asked whether
Mr Lemcke wanted the boat for excursions beyond Woosung. To this
question I was given the following reply :"We want it for outs-
ide of Shanghai." Whereupon I informed the person calling
himself Morris at the other end of the wire that I had a friend
whom I could perhaps prevail upon to sell his speed-boat, a
vessel capable of attaining a speed of 25 knots per hour. Morris

carry five or six passengers, there was no cargo space. This
shortcoming did not seem to affect my listener unfavourably
so I inquired what amount he was prepared to pay for a suitable
boat. After some hesitation he stated that "they" were prepared
to go as high as eight hundred dollars.
